I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the store is Pine Crossing.

That comes from her own post in #central-team on Jun 9 at 10:48 AM. The morning receiver had said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written down on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it with the store login.

I didn't find a street address or site code for Pine Crossing in the channel or the shared files. I told her that if the account sheet needs one, she'll have to get it from store ops.
